items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: I like Laura Namulemu. You know Laura Namulemu? She’s from London.

ctx.x: I haven’t been listening as much these last few months because I’ve been going to so many projects on my own. And when I do projects on my own I purposely don’t listen to a lot of other stuff. Honestly. But I like The Internet. I just kind of got hip to them last year. I like them, they have good vibes. I like Hiatus. They have good vibes. Those two
groups, as far as new rising, up-and-coming cats. You know what I mean? I like those people. I like Laura Namulemu. You know Laura Namulemu? She’s from London.

I have one or two more questions. For the record, you’ve covered David Bowie songs, he just passed. Maurice White Earth Wind & Fire just passed. Speak about those two in terms of your thoughts about them in particular.
